readerCopy.body: The path forward can become easier once a less conventional choice no longer has to be defended as a problem first. When Lilith trines the North Node, autonomy and forward movement reinforce each other, making refusal of an expected role capable of opening another route. Being misunderstood is not evidence that a choice is right, but approval is not evidence that the conventional choice is better either. The strongest direction is the one that becomes more workable once the actual preference is allowed into the plan.
